name: Pinocchio
hours_label: Family matinees · 4-show pass $25, single tickets at FST box office
blurb: Florida Studio Theatre opens its Children's Theatre season with this classic tale of a wooden puppet who dreams of becoming a real boy. A fast-paced, family-friendly 50-minute show at the Keating Theatre, it's an easy add for relocating families sizing up Sarasota's arts scene.

name: Legacy: Motown & More!
blurb: Florida Studio Theatre's Goldstein Cabaret serves up a high-energy revue of Motown, pop and R&B classics spanning the 1960s to today. Recently extended through October, it's a lively pick for date night or a night out in downtown Sarasota's theater district.

name: Wellen Park Oktoberfest
hours_label: 12 PM – 6 PM · Free admission (food/beer separate; $5 stein-hoisting entry)
blurb: Downtown Wellen Park's third annual German-style festival brings live polka, dancers, a stein-hoisting competition, and plenty of beer and brats to the Bradenton/Venice edge of the Sarasota market. Free to enter, with food and drinks sold à la carte — a fun outing for families and newcomers exploring the area.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
blurb: A beloved Siesta Key ritual: drummers, dancers and spectators gather on the sand to send off the sunset with rhythm. Free and open to everyone — bring a chair and enjoy one of Sarasota's most iconic outdoor scenes.
